The source way includes a short overlapping prefix outside its closed portion; the recipe uses the actual repeated source node as its closure. The operator identifies the same full configuration at 5.615 km; this independent source measures 5,594.4 m against the catalogue 5,666 m. No coordinates are adjusted. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 5594.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 80 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
